chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding the mention of those who went to Basra for his war (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's journey to Basra mentioned in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the context of the Battle of the Camel (656 CE), marking the first major civil conflict (Fitna) within the early Islamic community following the death of Caliph Uman. It sets the stage for Imam Ali’s (AS) rhetorical address to the Kufan and Basran troops, emphasizing their voluntary commitment to justice and his own legitimacy as the Commander of the Faithful against the forces of Aisha, Talhah, and Zubayr.
